The main takeaway from our work is that
the skin barrier is controlled by the influx of calcium and chlorine ions into keratinocytes through the activation of ionotropic receptors.

calcium influx into keratinocytes is detrimental to skin barrier homeostasis whereas chloride influx is beneficial.
